Package neqsim.process.processmodel

Class AdaptiveTransientStepper

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.AdaptiveTransientStepper
final class AdaptiveTransientStepper extends Object
Shared opt-in transactional step-doubling coordinator for process systems and models.

Callers exclusively own the model, participants and pure numerical providers throughout a call. This coordinator estimates local error; it does not replace a pressure-flow or DAE solve.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
